spans.s:
uccāṭana
(‘exorcising’)
------------------------------------------
Employment of spells for malevolent purposes is known as अभिचार and ābhicārika-कर्म.
The six types mentioned in the related works are: māraṇa (for causing the death of an enemy); mohana (for casting a spell); stambhana (for arresting the power of an enemy); vidveṣaṇa (for causing enmity); उच्चाटन (for throwing out or banishing) and vaśīkaraṇa (for hypnotising any person).
The rite of उच्चाटन can also be used for exorcising ghosts and evil spirits.
See also ABHICĀRA.
